info.title: InspectAI - Explainable Industrial Health Monitoring API
info.description: REST API for real-time vibration signal classification and Explainable AI (1D Grad-CAM). Processes continuous accelerometer time-series (12 kHz & 48 kHz), runs inference using the frozen 1D CNN, and generates temporal attribution heatmaps.

get.description: Reports the operational status of the API, model weights availability, and device configuration.

200.description: API and model are fully loaded and operational.

503.description: API is online but model loading failed or is incomplete.

post.description: Preprocesses raw continuous accelerometer vibration readings (resampling to 12 kHz, removing DC offset, and bandpass filtering), runs inference through the frozen 1D CNN, and optionally computes 1D Grad-CAM temporal attributions.

400.description: Invalid input signal, corrupt values, or incompatible length.

503.description: Prediction service unavailable because models are not loaded.

model_loaded.title: Model Loaded
model_loaded.description: Whether the frozen 1D CNN checkpoint is loaded and ready.

supported_classes.title: Supported Classes
supported_classes.description: List of recognized bearing fault categories.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Health check and model readiness status response.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Raw vibration acceleration samples in physical units (g).

sampling_rate_hz.title: Sampling Rate Hz
sampling_rate_hz.description: Nominal sampling rate in Hz (e.g. 12000 or 48000).

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: Whether to generate 1D Grad-CAM attribution heatmap.

target_class.title: Target Class
target_class.description: Optional class ID (0-3) or class name to explain. Defaults to predicted class.

PredictionRequest.title: PredictionRequest
PredictionRequest.description: Vibration signal inference and optional explanation request.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Uncalibrated model softmax scores across classes (Normal, Ball, Inner, Outer).

class_probabilities.title: Class Probabilities
class_probabilities.description: Mapping from class name to uncalibrated softmax score.

confidence_note.title: Confidence Note
confidence_note.description: Important notice stating softmax scores are uncalibrated and not empirical probabilities.

input_sampling_rate_hz.title: Input Sampling Rate Hz
input_sampling_rate_hz.description: Raw input sampling frequency in Hz.

processing_time_ms.title: Processing Time Ms
processing_time_ms.description: Total pipeline execution time in milliseconds.

gradcam_heatmap.title: Gradcam Heatmap
gradcam_heatmap.description: 1D Grad-CAM attribution scores [0.0, 1.0] across 2048 samples if explain=True.

target_class.title: Target Class
target_class.description: Class label targeted by Grad-CAM attribution.

important_regions.title: Important Regions
important_regions.description: Detected contiguous temporal intervals where attribution exceeds threshold.

PredictionResponse.title: PredictionResponse
PredictionResponse.description: Detailed fault prediction and XAI response container.

example.confidence_note: Softmax scores are uncalibrated model outputs and do not represent true empirical probabilities.
